Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left.
Complaints centered on low back pain and muscular tightness radiating into the paraspinal region, and the
mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash. No prior injury to the lumbar region is known from history or
records reviewed. Over the course of ten visits, the patient received manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home
exercise instruction. Palpation revealed paraspinal muscle guarding and reduced lumbar range of motion, which
support a soft tissue strain, while neurological screening and straight leg raise testing were within normal limits.
Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for a strain of this type, with gradual improvement noetd toward
